spec.title: Stage B: the smallest joint reach and deflection margins that make the manipulator robust under +/- 2 % tolerance
spec.hypothesis: Designed 2026-10-24 after stage A (margin-sweep-manipulator-isolated), with the same pre-registered criterion: every one of the 10 seeds' best designs must have a 95 % Wilson upper bound of at most 5 % on the failure rate over 1,000 independent +/- 2 % uniform perturbations, here for overall failure (any constraint). Stage A found the isolated thresholds reach 2 % (analytically guaranteed) and deflection 8 % (sampled only; box corners fail below 12 %), and that a reach margin alone raises deflection failures from 32 % to about 50 % by lengthening the links. Hypotheses: (1) the joint threshold is reach 2 % with deflection 8 %, if the deflection margin absorbs the longer links; otherwise the interaction raises the required deflection margin. (2) A uniform margin needs about 8-10 % on every constraint and costs more than the targeted pair. (3) CMA-ES reaches the same conclusion at the candidate joint points. Stress is not margined; it never failed in stage A.
